pillar: AI tools that change marketing work

slides.title: Stop *switching tabs*. Connect your tools inside ChatGPT
slides.subtitle: Add verified apps in minutes and pull live data straight into chat

slides.label: 01 · Ensure you have ChatGPT Plus
slides.title: Developer Mode requires Plus
slides.body: Developer Mode, needed for MCP servers, is only available on Plus, Pro, Team, Enterprise and Edu plans. Free plans cannot use MCP servers. The Plus plan starts at $20 per month.

slides.label: 02 · Open Settings → Apps
slides.title: Find the Apps marketplace
slides.body: In ChatGPT click your name, choose Settings, then select Apps. This opens the marketplace where you can search for verified connectors.

slides.label: 03 · Add Adspirer
slides.title: Connect multi-platform ad management
slides.body: Search for Adspirer, click Connect and authorise your Google, Meta, Amazon, ChatGPT Ads, LinkedIn and TikTok accounts. Adspirer has been an official listing since May 29 2026 and connects to over 400 tools across six platforms. Since June 2026 it returns interactive in-chat dashboards with tabbed Overview, Campaigns and Insights views.

slides.label: 04 · Add HubSpot plugin
slides.title: Enable CRM access
slides.body: The HubSpot plugin lets you read contact lists, deal stages and trigger workflows using natural language. It works across claude.ai, Claude Desktop and other ChatGPT surfaces, giving you live CRM data without leaving the chat.

slides.label: 05 · Add Zapier plugin
slides.title: Build automations by description
slides.body: With the Zapier plugin you describe an automation, for example “When a new lead arrives in HubSpot, add a row to Google Sheets”, and Zapier builds it inside the chat. You can then run or edit the workflow by conversation.

slides.label: 06 · Test with a live data prompt
slides.title: See real numbers in chat
slides.body: Try a prompt such as “Show me my worst performing campaigns this month” to see real numbers from your ad accounts. The answer appears as an interactive dashboard you can filter by date range.
